verdict.rationale: GrowthBook's pricing page lists "Advanced permissioning" (Pro) and "Advanced access control" (Enterprise), so the product does claim role and permission controls of its own. That support is only a pair of pricing bullets, with no docs on how roles are scoped to specific flags, projects, or environments. Approval workflows and read-only SDK endpoints are adjacent features and are not credited here. Missing for 10: documented role definitions and per-flag/project/environment permission scoping, scoped management API tokens, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a platform engineer, I can restrict who can change which flags with roles, permissions, and scoped API tokens
